name: Stoga
description: Stoga was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. A dry, desert world of large canyons and craggy rock formations, Stoga was largely overlooked by the galactic governments due to its remote location—making it a haven for smugglers, outlaws and mercenaries to keep a low profile.
lead_paragraphs: Stoga was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. A dry, desert world of large canyons and craggy rock formations, Stoga was largely overlooked by the galactic governments due to its remote location—making it a haven for smugglers, outlaws and mercenaries to keep a low profile.
